The idea is simple: a licence the federation renews after site audits, and that plume alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the forge compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The fable is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
